sahneler.metin: An Argentine submarine vanished during a routine patrol.
Within hours, sensors picked up a sound consistent with an implosion.
Its last report described a problem.
Seawater had leaked through the snorkel into the batteries.
All forty four crew were lost.
The wreck was found a year later at great depth.
Argentina's naval readiness came under scrutiny.
